headline: Mid-afternoon. Cloud unbroken.
body: Seventeen degrees under a still-full overcast, wind from the south at fourteen kilometres. The drizzle has thinned to almost nothing; streets remain damp and traffic moves without hurry. The light stays flat, the sun nowhere near clearing.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: overcast, 17°C, wind 14 km/h S, rain eased
